headline: Peru Allocates 61.5 Million Soles to Support Fishery Sector Affected by El Niño
summary: The Peruvian government approved 61.5 million soles in economic relief measures for the fishing industry. The package includes credit risk coverage for industrial fisheries and 1,500-sol subsidies for artisanal fishermen.
why: Peru is the world's leading exporter of fishmeal and fish oil, products sensitive to El Niño ocean temperature anomalies.

impacts.name: Peruvian Fishing Sector
impacts.why: Government relief subsidies and credit guarantees mitigate climate-related revenue losses.
